verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada holds a filer's corporate records, so data portability is a fair question. However, the pack documents no self-service bulk export of a corporation's data in open formats. 'Order copies of corporate documents' is an adjacent document-request feature, not a full data export. The open.canada.ca CKAN JSON API belongs to the separate national open-data platform, and the probe notes the registry itself documents no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
